title.zh: 卡 C-2：NP5-01a C-1 复核低项/观察处置（英文否定声明 + reviewed 语义 + errata 记录）+ C 批 force/energy 68 站点 source 级（零 GPU）
title.en: Card C-2: NP5-01a C-1 review low/observation close-out (English negated declarations, reviewed semantics, errata record) + C batch force/energy 68 sites source-level (zero GPU)

intent.zh: 第一节承接 C-1 复核 1 低 + 2 观察：①L1 policy_scan 声明否定漏洞补英文——DECLARATION_NEGATORS 增 not/no/never/without/none/cannot 等并加词边界检查，never supersede/no withdrawal/must not supersede 不再豁免、supersedes: 仍豁免，自测 24→28/28；②O1 在 docstring/README 写明 --list-quote-blocks 的 reviewed 字段只表示块内标记存在与否、痕迹可在 receipt quote_block_inventory；③O2 将 flex_hessian_validate field-table 描述滞后记入 evidence/receipt 的 errata_pending（本片仅记录，不改 field-table 历史，收尾 addenda 统一入清单）。第二节 C-2：force/energy 5 组 68 站点（fluid_force 27/kinetic_energy 13/applied_force 12/smooth_force 9/passive_force 7）source 级：类型映射 + 表达式分类（六类词表，双侧 file:line），自检 68/pending=0/词表合法/policy 扫描 0 命中；NP5-01a 累计 269+68=337。零 GPU、零窗；不改 src/tests/fixtures/判据/参考/容差。
intent.en: Section 1 closes C-1 review: (1) add English negators to the declaration check with word-boundary matching so 'never supersede'/'no withdrawal'/'must not supersede' do not exempt and 'supersedes:' does, self-tests 24->28/28; (2) document that the --list-quote-blocks `reviewed` field only means an in-block marker exists, with the trace possibly in the receipt inventory; (3) record the flex_hessian_validate field-table drift in errata_pending (record only; field-table history unchanged; closing addenda consolidates). Section 2: force/energy 68 sites source-level, selfcheck 68/pending=0/policy 0 hits; cumulative 269+68=337. Zero GPU/window.

acceptance: `scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py` 增英文否定词（含词边界检查），never supersede/no withdrawal/must not supersede 不豁免、supersedes: 豁免；自测 28/28 PASS；sha256/bytes 记入 C-2 evidence。
docstring + C-2 README 写明 `--list-quote-blocks` 的 `reviewed` 字段语义（块内标记存在与否；false≠未复核，痕迹可在 receipt）。
C-2 evidence/receipt 含 `errata_pending`（errata-0001：flex_hessian_validate field-table 滞后：ok/status vs i32 flags），status=recorded、不改 field-table 历史。

`docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-c2/`：evidence.json（68 站点、5 组、类型映射 + 表达式分类 + 双侧 file:line）、README、receipt（verdict=PASS、site_count=68、pending_manual=0、np5_01a_total_sites=337、section1 三布尔 true、ptx_landed=false）、logs/selfcheck.txt、manifest 逐文件 sha256+bytes 自核；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM。
边界：写域仅 `docs/development-evidence/np-gate/np5-01a-c2/**` + `scripts/np-gate/policy_scan.py` + `.normify/**`；`src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/` 零改动；零 GPU、零窗；不改判据/参考/容差。
四门禁 + normify check；中文提交。
note: C-1 复核 1 低（英文否定声明漏洞）+ 2 观察（reviewed 字段语义；field-table errata 记录）并入第一节；C-2 为 force/energy 68 站点。零 GPU。
